name: Zenithal-Corbel
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait a tidally locked hemisphere, and everything the light never reaches.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
